en: Black-and-white street scene showing a modernist low commercial building on a corner with large windows and awnings. Pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across a broad square with tram or trolleybus wires and tall street lamps overhead. Leafless trees line the pavement. On the roof are large neon-style signs in a Nordic language, and in the foreground bottom-left is caption text identifying the location as Helsinki and the building as Lasipalatsi.
